# The British Manor

> Luxury furniture, wall panels, lighting and clocks for British interiors. Fast UK delivery, trade pricing, and a portfolio of real installations.

Canonical domain: https://thebritishmanor.co.uk
Contact: hello@thebritishmanor.co.uk
Sitemap: https://thebritishmanor.co.uk/sitemap.xml

## Categories

- Wall panels — acoustic, slatted, MDF, flexible, paintable
- Lighting — statement pendants, sconces and lamps
- Clocks — heritage and contemporary timepieces
- Furniture — luxury living, dining and bedroom pieces
- Interiors — curated accessories and styling
